posts.name: Chromium_Man
posts.cooked:
I unlocked her, but I have no idea how.  Here's everything that was going down.

GloomWeaver vs. Legacy, Dark Watch Expatriette, Argent Adept, and NightMist in the Realm of Discord

At the beginning of NightMist's turn, the following cards were in play:

 

GloomWeaver:  Grimoire of Curses, Bag of Bones, 2x Chosen Disciple, Cursed Acolyte, some number of Zombies

Legacy:  Incapacitated

Dark Watch Expatriette:  Assault Rifle, Submachine Gun, Pride, Prejudice, Hairtrigger Reflexes

Argent Adept:  Inspiring Supertonic, Rhapsody of Vigor, Akbunkh's Drum, Musaraghi's Harp, Eydisar's Horn, Sarabande of Destruction, Alacritous Subdominant, Counterpoint Bulwark

NightMist:  Amulet of the Elder Gods, Master of Magic, Tome of Elder Magic, Crimson Pin

I played Oblivion with a magic value of 1 and flipped two 4s:  Astral Premonition and Mists of Time.  I killed a ton of targets, I redirected the first instance of Oblivion damage dealt to NightMist with the Amulet.

 

My theories are that either a) It's just the amount of damage that is done in the turn or the amount of targets killed, not necessarily 2x 4s.  The 4s might just help by increasing the damage.

b)  I haven't seen anyone else mention it in their unlock so I'm probably wrong, but might it be that you have to redirect the damage with the Amulet?  Edit:  In fact, looking at the screenshot above and seeing that NightMist is at full health, I'd like to officially make this one my recommendation.  Someone else try it out and if it's true, I hope it's enough to get in the Hall of Fame :)

 

Just to be more clear:  Try playing Oblivion regardless of the magic value and then use the Amulet of the Elder Gods to redirect the damage that would be dealt to NightMist.

Got it.  Not 100% sure on what triggered it exactly, but it sounds like what a lot of other people are reporting.  Here we go-

Argent Adept, Tempest, Greatest Legacy, Nightmist, DW Expat, in that order.

Realm of Discord (pretty sure that's a must), Time Flies, Portal Fiend.

Gloomweaver, 2 Chosen Disciples, 2 Cursed Acolytes, 1 Profane Zealot, the book and the drum, and the Indigo Pin, on NM.

NM had Master of Magic and her book out.  Might be worth noting that her deck was empty, 17 cards in the trash, the rest in hand.

Played Oblivion (3) to a 4/4 combo.  Told it to choose the damage order for me since there were so many targets.

I heard the theory about Mistfueled Recovery earlier, which I normally don't use (Tempest and Legs keep my health high enough I don't usually need it).  So I made sure to cast that a few times.  One round while Time Flies was out, I even used the Recovery followed immediately by Oblivion and that didn't work.

It might have been due to hitting a LOT of targets, or possibly from an insanely high damage total (I'm not even going to try to calculate all that).  I do know that in all my failures, I didn't use Mistfueled Recovery, so I'm leaning toward that theory.  Also, since the description in her bio mentions fighting off a large group of enemies before returning to Earth, that may also be part of it.  If the story has something to do with it, I did kill the Portal Fiend, which kinda matches.

My theory; use Mistbound Recovery at least once, cast Oblivion (maybe against a lot of targets), and kill a Portal Fiend.  Has anybody else noticed if environment targets are a common theme?  Not necessarily at the end, just at all.  Edit: oh yeah, and Expat.  duh.
